digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler peer confirmation from snapshots
propositions: Links observed in authoritative remote snapshots must be confirmed as peer-created even if never pushed locally by this clone.
Absent issuelinks key in snapshot entry indicates an unobserved (partial/failed/stale) read and must be skipped entirely; only present keys (including empty lists) are evidence.
Snapshot link confirmations are recorded with direction resolved through link_direction vocabulary, direction='snapshot', source='snapshot', and confirmed_pass set to current pass_id.
Snapshot confirmation logic must fail open: exceptions are logged to stderr and do not break the reconcile pass or prevent binding_store.save().
Link confirmation is monotonic and additive; no un-confirmation is performed even when issuelinks is authoritatively empty.
